# Synthetic contact-center regression fixtures

`contact-center-v2.xml` and `contact-center.json` exercise the explicit service-plus-unassigned-cost model. All requests, agents, capacities and costs are synthetic test data. They are not an official catalog package, a publisher declaration, live service records or recommended commercial terms.

These fixtures adapt the repository's Apache-2.0 mathematical XML assignment structure for explicit omission costs. The repository LICENSE applies; no existing attribution is replaced and no new copyright owner or license is asserted.
